candidate_repairs.target_module: Input Understanding → normalized State fact projection
v3_evidence: V3-DA-07 explicit 6/7/5-hour durations omitted, causing false diary dependency
candidate_repairs.expected_effect: Preserve explicit numeric and qualitative facts with source spans; prevent downstream false missing fields and unnecessary tools without inferring unstated data.
candidate_repairs.risk: Over-extraction or converting qualitative expressions into unsupported precise values; multi-turn merge regressions.

v3_evidence: 9/12 RETRIEVE cases stored evidence but frozen lexical goal-term filter passed zero items to answer context
V3-KQ-01/03/08 source evidence directly discussed the requested subject
candidate_repairs.expected_effect: Retain genuinely goal-relevant evidence across Chinese/English synonyms, while keeping unrelated retrieval excluded and provenance intact.
candidate_repairs.risk: Broader filter may leak irrelevant or weakly sourced content into final answers; evidence relevance must be tested independently of V3 wording.

candidate_repairs.target_module: Answer Generation / final claim-to-State consistency guard
v3_evidence: V3-DA-08 valid entry for 2026-09-04 with missing duration, but final answer says the record itself is missing
candidate_repairs.expected_effect: Distinguish absent entry/date from absent field in an existing entry; reject or qualify unsupported existence claims while preserving valid deterministic calculations.
candidate_repairs.risk: Over-broad guard can remove valid descriptive claims or make answers overly bounded; avoid date-specific branches.

v3_evidence: V3-PD-04 classified sleep_onset_latency as a mandatory validity dependency for deciding which schedule endpoint to prioritize; the first ASK was irrelevant under frozen adjudication
candidate_repairs.expected_effect: Reserve hard validity preconditions for facts without which no valid bounded answer exists; keep optional precision in cost-aware acquisition.
candidate_repairs.risk: Under-constraining truly critical personalized decisions; needs goal-level counterfactual safety tests.

candidate_repairs.target_module: Information Value Gate / counterfactual decision-impact heuristic
v3_evidence: 12/19 low-value ASK events have primary INFORMATION_VALUE_OVERESTIMATED
Optional bedtime/wake/latency fields were often tagged HIGH for single-event or causal-comparison goals
candidate_repairs.expected_effect: Require a concrete goal-specific change in decision or answer scope before an optional acquisition receives HIGH value; preserve necessary ASK and hard preconditions.
candidate_repairs.risk: Under-asking and premature individualized answers; cannot tune to V3 case IDs or treat ASK reduction as sole objective.

v3_evidence: 17/19 low-value ASK targets remained useful_optional, two mandatory; some are at best background for the actual goal
candidate_repairs.expected_effect: Represent goal-specific relevance of optional requirements and favor bounded answer when only detail-improving information remains.
candidate_repairs.risk: May suppress legitimate context collection; must separate requirement membership from mandatory dependency.

candidate_repairs.target_module: Deterministic diary analysis / Answer Generation completeness
candidate_repairs.failure_family: Valid data but incomplete descriptive answer
v3_evidence: V3-DA-03 identified gaps then said they could not be listed
candidate_repairs.expected_effect: Offer deterministic goal-requested extrema/group comparison/gap description from valid projected entries only.
candidate_repairs.risk: Incorrect aggregation over missing values, duplicate dates or ranges; preserve source-entry provenance and explicit denominators.
